response.text:
I can’t summarize the file from its name alone. To produce a real, accurate summary of Q4-results-final.pdf I need the PDF itself or equivalent content plus a few preferences. Please provide the items below (or tell me which you’ll provide) and answer the short questions so I can proceed.

Required inputs
- The PDF file (upload here) OR a public download link with access permissions OR the document text pasted into the chat.
- If the PDF contains images/charts/tables that you want analyzed, either:
  - provide the original data (CSV/Excel), or
  - upload the PDF (or high-resolution images of the charts/tables).

Scope and focus (choose or specify)
- Full document or specific pages/sections? (e.g., pages 1–10, “Financials” section)
- Intended audience and purpose? (executive, board, investors, internal team)

Level of detail and format (choose or specify)
- Short executive summary (1 paragraph + 3–5 key bullets)
- Medium summary (1 page, section-by-section highlights)
- Detailed summary (full outline, page references, notable quotes)
- Deliverable format: plain bullets, numbered list, slide-ready bullets, Word/Markdown summary

Data and citation options
- Do you want page-by-page citations or inline page numbers for facts/quotes?
- Should I include verbatim quotes? If yes, mark whether short quotes only or longer excerpts allowed.

Numeric/chart handling
- If you want exact numbers from charts/tables, provide source data or confirm I should extract numbers visually (I’ll state uncertainty and approximate when extracting visually).
- Do you want tables converted to CSV/Excel?

Privacy and redaction
- Is the document confidential? Any parts to omit or redact from the summary?

Additional tasks (optional)
- Recommendations or suggested action items based on findings?
- A short slide deck (3–5 slides) summarizing the key points?
- Translation or tone adjustment (formal, plain language)?

Suggested default if you don’t specify
- I will read the PDF, produce: (a) a one-paragraph executive summary, (b) 5–8 key bullets with page references, (c) a short section-by-section outline, and (d) 3 recommended actions. Indicate if you want that.

Next step
- Upload the PDF or paste the text (or give an accessible link) and tell me which scope/format you prefer. I’ll confirm and then produce the requested summary.
